services.sessionTypeCareerDesc: What to study and why. We map your interests and strengths to realistic, well-matched paths.
services.faqA1: Come with a specific question or a clear goal for the session. If it's a personal statement review, have your draft open. If it's a shortlist session, make a note of the subjects and countries you're considering.
services.faqA2: That's up to you. The session follows your agenda. I'll push back if something isn't working and tell you what I actually think — not what you want to hear.
services.faqA3: Full refund if you cancel more than 24 hours before the call. No refund within 24 hours of your scheduled slot.
